name: Create reviewed process videos and schedule them with Metricool

parameters.content:
## Who this is for
Creators producing narrated process videos from reviewed photos, with optional scheduling to Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and TikTok.

### How it works
The manual demo validates synthetic input without external calls. Operators upload a scene manifest and image ZIP through a protected form. Validation checks chronological stages, completion coverage, safe filenames, caption lengths and explicit reviewed face boxes. An optional opening completion image introduces the result before the process begins. The supplied renderer produces masked previews in landscape or portrait. Human face approval precedes narration generation. Measured speech lengths control scene timing; motion affects photos while captions remain fixed. After encoding and full decoding, scene start, middle and end frames are extracted. The operator plays the complete video and checks these frames before final approval. Download is available without social scheduling. Optional Metricool scheduling requires a second approval of caption, title, UTC time and public media release. A durable per-video claim prevents blind duplicate scheduling. Returned scheduler IDs and individual provider statuses are recorded; accepted schedules do not prove publication. A fifteen-minute monitoring branch records each network’s publication status.

### Setup
Download the renderer from Export setup files. Run it with FFmpeg, Japanese fonts and its documented dependencies. Configure renderer and OpenAI credentials in n8n. Keep Metricool disabled until Advanced or Custom API access, three connected accounts, network options and a stable public HTTPS media origin are verified. Configure X-Mc-Auth as a separate credential. Portrait videos must be under 175 seconds for this shared publishing route. Do not shorten by dropping required stages. Use rights-cleared photos; inspect every image before preparing the manifest. Never embed tokens or personal information in the exported template.

parameters.content:
## 01 • Validate the scene plan
Manual demo or protected form. Require every stage, chronological scenes, safe filenames and explicit reviewed face boxes. Monitoring requests branch to the independent lower lane.

## 02 • Review masked previews
Upload assets, inspect every preview and approve face coverage. No narration or rendering starts until this approval.

## 03 • Narrate and render
Generate and upload one audio clip per scene; the loop returns to Process one scene. Render once, then poll until complete. Lower exits stop on failure.

## 04 • Approve the encoded video
Play the full video and inspect QA frames. Record approval before download or public release. Metricool is optional and disabled by default.

## 05 • Review the three-network schedule
Check API access, account connections and network options. Approve caption, title and future UTC time. Declining scheduling still permits video download.

## 06 • Release approved media
Release only the approved MP4 hash to a stable HTTPS URL. Validate the URL and normalize the media in Metricool.

## 07 • Reserve once and record receipts
Build a three-network post, claim it once and store scheduler IDs with individual network states. An accepted schedule is not proof of publication. Inspect Metricool before reconciling uncertainty.

## 08 • Download the reviewed MP4
Deliver the same approved video after optional scheduling. No further scheduling is performed by this endpoint.

## 09 • Monitor recorded publications
The fifteen-minute trigger uses the shared configuration, then reads saved post IDs and records individual network outcomes. It never creates a new reservation.
